name: WHO Beta Tester
title: Clean caller experience
message: The caller screen feels much cleaner than my normal phone app. I like having the number and identity context in one place.

name: Early Tester
title: I want to keep testing this
message: The beta is still early, but the direction is very promising. The contacts and caller-ID idea together makes sense.

name: Beta Tester
title: Simple and easy to understand
message: The interface is easy to follow. I would love stronger spam information and contact backup in the next updates.
